text:
jin: Heads up — seeing recurring prefill jams on small VPC slices after the slice-packing change. Latency spikes and a burst of KV evictions followed by kernel fallback.

matt: Can you paste the profiler snippet and the slice config? Curious if it's the packing threshold or the token budget target.

jin: Profiling excerpt (from rdwf-prof on a repro run):
```text
2026-03-12 14:02:11.234 kernel_selector: chose kernel xform_f32 for seq_len=512
2026-03-12 14:02:11.239 batcher: slice 3 packed 7 reqs -> prefill budget hit
2026-03-12 14:02:11.242 kv_cache: evict start tenant=A hysteresis=0.05
2026-03-12 14:02:11.245 runtime: fallback to generic_gemm (higher latency)
2026-03-12 14:02:11.260 batcher: queue oscillation detected (pack/unpack loop)
``` 

jin: Slice config for affected VPC: `slice.size=smallgpu`, `slice.pack_threshold=0.85`, `batch.max_tokens=2048`, `token_budget.target=900`.

lina: Sounds like pack_threshold too aggressive for smallgpu memory frag patterns. When pack_threshold>>0.7 we sometimes force prefill to pack requests that then cause KV eviction pressure. Try lowering to 0.65 and increase `kv.evict_hysteresis=0.15`.

pranav: Also noticed kernel selector reverted to generic_gemm when memory transiently dips. That was a change in 7f2d8c9 yesterday that enabled `prefer_f32_kernels_for_small_slices=true`. Reverting that for small slices might stop the fallback.

matt: Quick validation plan: 1) patch slice config: pack_threshold=0.65 + kv.evict_hysteresis=0.15 2) disable prefer_f32 flag for slice.size=smallgpu 3) run `rdwf-prof --scenario=vpc-small-pack --runs=50` 4) watch prefill queue depth + eviction rate.

jin: I ran step 1 locally — pack_threshold=0.65 dropped prefill congestion in the short run. Evictions dropped ~60% and no generic_gemm fallback in 30s sample. Will paste logs if CI run passes.

deploy-bot: canary deploy of config patch `slice-config-2026-03-12` started to 3/10 smallgpu slices.

ops-bot: Alert suppressed: transient prefill-jam rate reduced after canary. We will monitor for 1 hour before full rollout. :eyes:

lina: If canary looks good, follow up with longer run to confirm kernel selection stability. Also consider adding a packing jitter to avoid synchronized pack waves: `batch.pack_jitter_ms=12`.

pranav: Filed a tiny revert PR for the kernel-default flag and a followup ticket to add per-slice kernel heuristics (TICKET-2341). Linking to perf trace: https://perf.redwood/s/trace/2017654321

matt: Great. If ops sees re-regression after revert we can try conservative per-tenant token_budget.target reductions. For now, move config to full rollout if 1h looks stable. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
